latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Linux Ollama — multi-machine Ollama fleet routing for Linux.

- Run Ollama inference across multiple Linux machines with automatic load balancing and routing.
- Supports setup for Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, Mistral models on servers, desktops, and edge devices.
- Integrates with systemd for reliable service management.
- Provides a dashboard, fleet health checks, and structured logging.
- Includes firewall configuration, GPU/CPU tips, and OpenAI API compatibility.
- No automatic model downloads or deletions; all actions require user confirmation.
